platform_overview.name: CampusEase
platform_overview.description: A comprehensive full-stack web application designed to facilitate accommodation and vehicle rentals specifically for university students and staff at Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka.
platform_overview.purpose: Connects verified university members with property and vehicle owners, creating a trusted marketplace within the university community.

ai_assistant.name: CampusEase AI Assistant
capabilities: Answering questions about platform policies and procedures
Explaining how to book accommodations or vehicles
Providing information about cancellation and refund policies
Guiding users through the verification process
Sharing contact information and office hours
Explaining user roles (Student, Staff, Owner, Admin)
ai_assistant.technology: Uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with conversation memory to provide accurate, context-aware responses

policy_overview.cancellation_window: Up to 24 hours before scheduled time

important_notes: Provider cancellations: Immediate student notification + full refund (no action needed from student)
All cancellations must be done through the platform
Cancellations within 24 hours may not be eligible for refund

for_students_staff.details: Go to 'Accommodation' or 'Vehicle' page. Use filters to narrow down options (price, location, type, amenities). Click on listings to view detailed information and photos.
Click the heart icon to save items to your favorites list. Access saved items from your dashboard.

Select your desired dates (for accommodations) or rental period (for vehicles). Click 'Book Now' on the listing. Review the total price (automatic calculation based on duration). Choose payment method: Credit Card or Pay-on-Hand. Confirm booking details.

details.credit_card: Immediate payment, refunds processed in 5-7 working days if canceled
details.pay_on_hand: Reserve now, pay later at the time of check-in/pickup

for_students_staff.details: You'll receive email confirmation. View all bookings in 'My Bookings' section. Track booking status (Pending, Confirmed, Canceled, Completed).

important_notes: You must be a verified university member to book
Some listings may require owner approval before confirmation

automatic_actions: Immediate email notification with booking details
Booking appears in 'My Bookings' dashboard automatically
if_need_to_cancel_or_modify: Check the booking in your dashboard
Cancel if needed: Follow standard cancellation process (24-hour window applies). Full refund if canceled within policy timeframe.
Contact Support for any discrepancies: email support@campusease.lk, phone +94 (45) 123-4567, or visit during office hours
if_booking_is_incorrect: Do not confirm or accept the booking
Contact support immediately with: your name and university email, booking reference number, description of the issue
Support team will resolve within 24-48 hours

general.question: How long does it take to receive a reply?
general.answer: We aim to respond to all inquiries within 24-48 hours during business days. For urgent matters, please call our support line during office hours.

general.question: Can I update or delete my account?
general.answer: Yes! You can update your profile information anytime from your dashboard. For account deletion, please contact support with your request and verification details.

general.question: What kind of technical issues do you handle?
general.answer: We assist with login problems, booking errors, payment issues, profile updates, verification problems, and any platform navigation questions.

general.question: Do you provide support for accommodation and transport?
general.answer: Absolutely! We can help with finding listings, understanding policies, resolving booking disputes, and connecting with owners.

booking.question: How do I cancel a booking?
booking.answer: Go to 'My Bookings' → Select the booking → Click 'Cancel Booking' → Provide reason → Confirm. Must be done at least 24 hours before scheduled time.

booking.question: When will I get my refund?
booking.answer: Refunds for paid bookings are processed within 5-7 working days after cancellation.

booking.question: What if the owner cancels my booking?
booking.answer: You'll receive immediate notification and automatic full refund. No action needed from your side.

booking.question: Can I modify a booking after confirmation?
booking.answer: Modification depends on owner approval. Contact the owner directly through the platform or cancel and rebook if within policy.
